pins.host_note: resolve_runtime(backend, requested, platform, installed, gpu), runtime_id(backend, device, platform, gpu), nvidia_gpu_runtime(platform, gpu), missing_runtime(model, settings, platform, installed, gpu): the platform tag, installed component ids and NVML GPU ([name, MiB, [major, minor] or None] or None) are patched in; CTranslate2's CUDA count is 1 exactly when a GPU is given
